WITH rating_rentals AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rent_count
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(rent_count) AS overall_avg
  FROM rating_rentals
),
above_average_ratings AS (
  SELECT rr.rent_count
  FROM rating_rentals rr
  WHERE rr.rent_count > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_average)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(rent_count) AS avg_above_average,
  AVG(rent_count) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_average) AS difference
FROM above_average_ratings
